title: Importing the native services capture must not silently discard recovery semantics

provenance.note: Anchored to the same genuine GPMC capture as native-recovery-units. The expected behavior is stated against Studio's public parse path (parse_gpp_services via the backup importer), which an operator actually runs; current behavior is known to violate it and the violation is the WI-022 parse-side finding.

authored_intent.operator_action: Import the committed WI01A-Services-GPMC backup through Studio's backup-import path and inspect the resulting services items.

expected_native.loss_policy: Every recovery attribute present in the capture must surface in the Studio model either as a typed field or as preserved unknown content that a later export re-emits. A value that vanishes at parse time and is absent from any re-export is a silent drop and fails this scenario; it is the reader-side half of WI-022. Attributes GPMC itself omitted (Spooler thirdFailure, W32Time recovery set) must remain absent, not materialize as defaults on re-export.

current_behavior.observed: parse_gpp_services drops thirdFailure, resetFailCountDelay, and restartServiceDelay entirely: they are neither typed model fields nor preserved unknown content, and a re-export emits the synthetic resetPeriod/restartDelay names instead. Recorded here so the divergence is executable documentation; this block is removed when WI-022 lands and the scenario flips to passing.
